evidence.claim: Against a local registry that accepts immediately then trickles 1 byte / 50ms (~20 B/s, below a 400 B/s floor), the production client raises classification=network-fault (kind read-timeout or throughput-floor) with wall-clock elapsed <= declared read_timeout 0.35s + margin 0.90s. The classification is not unit-timeout. The same server serving /fast at full speed returns the expected payload well under the read timeout (both-states).
